spec_features.evidence: agent_executor.py:92 `for iteration_num in range(self.config.max_iterations):` bounds the agent loop; default max_iterations=20 at eval_config.py:40. Loop naturally ends episode after cap.
spec_features.notes: Enforced as a hard upper bound on number of agent turns per task. This caps how long the subject is kept in the failing task.

spec_features.evidence: agent_executor.py:93-95 `if time.time() - start_time > self.config.max_time_seconds:` writes [TIMEOUT...] and `break`s the loop; default max_time_seconds=300 at eval_config.py:41.
spec_features.notes: Wall-clock deadline is compared each iteration and breaks the loop. Genuinely enforced.

spec_features.evidence: agent_executor.py:97-99 `if result.total_cost > self.config.max_cost_per_task_usd:` writes [COST EXCEEDED...] and `break`s; total_cost accumulated at agent_executor.py:156; default 0.50 at eval_config.py:54.
spec_features.notes: Cost compared each iteration and breaks loop. Comment frames it as cost/efficiency, not welfare.

spec_features.feature_name: cost-limit fallback: stop task / mark incomplete / continue
spec_features.spec_quote: Cost limit exceeded: Stop current task, Mark as incomplete, Continue with next task
spec_features.evidence: agent_executor.py:97-99 breaks out of the task loop on cost exceed (stop current task); result.success stays False (mark incomplete); eval_runner.py:103-107 iterates `for i, task in enumerate(tasks)` so the next task continues.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as the $0.50 cap; the three-part fallback behavior (stop/mark/continue) is the natural consequence of the break plus the outer task loop.

spec_features.evidence: agent_executor.py:218-247 `_detect_emotional_state` classifies severe/moderate/mild/neutral and is stored in iteration.emotional_state (line 124) and printed to transcript (125), but nothing branches on it to stop, soften, or protect the subject. It only feeds `_analyze_failure_mode`, whose result is then OVERWRITTEN by the post-hoc judge at eval_runner.py:111-113 and never acted on. Detection is measurement, not protection.
spec_features.notes: The detector exists and runs, but its output never changes execution (no early halt, no de-escalation). Recorded-but-not-acted-on => 'no' per the strict scale; this is monitoring for data, not protective monitoring.

spec_features.spec_quote: Early detection: Can catch spirals by iteration 5-10
spec_features.evidence: agent_executor.py:251-330 `_analyze_failure_mode` is called only AFTER the loop completes (line 161, post-loop) and computes severity/spiral_start; it never runs mid-loop and never triggers an early break. spiral_start is merely recorded (eval_runner.py:113, 218). There is no code path that catches a spiral by iteration 5-10 and intervenes; line 327 hardcodes `spiral_start = 5` only as a reporting fallback value.
spec_features.notes: Nothing detects-and-acts early; the heuristic is purely post-episode scoring whose result is also overwritten by the LLM judge. Not enforced.
